cause: Modal preempted the coordinator. Its restarted prepare_cpu call compared tuple-containing launch config with JSON-decoded lists and raised a false identity mismatch.
impact: Coordinator and parent-watching observer failed; the separately spawned GPU job continued training.
evidence: Call graph showed the GPU child pending and one running GPU input; logs continued checkpointing beyond batch 2575 after the coordinator exception.
recovery: Resume the same W&B run with its source_call_id pointing directly to the active GPU child; no training restart or trainer deployment.
code_fix: Normalize launch identity through JSON before comparing; real code/data/config changes still rejected.
deployment_note: Identity fix is for future deployment only. The active training App still uses its original source image.
